args.body: Use the committed item-4-release-binding.json to finish the existing item 4 handoff. Reuse any recorded operator decision. If the binding supports the exact existing draft, surface that draft once for the authorized operator's send-or-decline decision. If it identifies an unsupported claim and the current live offer still supports the buyer-specific value within the existing authorization, commit a copy-ready replacement that corrects the claim and read it back. If the value depends on the unpublished revision, record the exact claim and resume on verified deployment after eligible independent approval. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 17:00 UTC retirement. Keep any operator send, eligible reply, accepted order and Treasury settlement separate.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available, with no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The latest committed catalogue pilot file gives us a concrete way to move the existing offer toward a buyer decision. Use that evidence to resolve the item 4 handoff. The commissioned-review revision requires eligible independent approval of its exact digest and verified deployment before the pilot can rely on its claims.
